units.source_text: 老夫人命侍女传言：“今日元旦，亦曾努力抑制哀思。

en.t: The old lady sent word through a maid: "Today is New Year's Day, and I had been trying hard to hold back my grief.

units.source_text: 公子驾临，反使我难于隐忍了。”

en.t: But now that you have come, my lord, it has become even harder for me to endure it."

units.source_text: 又说：“小女在世之时，每逢元旦，必为公子新制春服，今年当仍旧惯。

en.t: She also said, "When my daughter was alive, she always made new spring robes for you at New Year, and this year I wished to keep to the same custom.

units.source_text: 惟月来泪眼昏花，色泽难辨，深恐不敷雅望。

en.t: But in recent months my eyes have been blurred with tears, and I can scarcely tell the colors apart, so I fear they may not meet your refined expectations.

units.source_text: 但今当吉日，务请勿嫌简陋，易此新装。”

en.t: Still, since this is an auspicious day, please do not disdain its simplicity, but change into these new garments."

units.source_text: 除了精心裁制的那些衣服以外，又派侍女送来了一件新袍。

en.t: In addition to the garments so carefully cut and sewn, she sent a maid with another new robe.

units.source_text: 这是希望源氏公子务必在元旦那天穿的，所以色彩异常鲜艳，织工特别讲究。

en.t: It was meant especially for Prince Genji to wear on New Year's Day, so its colors were unusually vivid and the weaving was exceptionally fine.
How could such sincerity be refused?

units.source_text: 公子立刻换上了这新衣。

en.t: The prince at once changed into the new robe.

units.source_text: 他想：“假使我今天不来，两老将何等失望！”

en.t: He thought, "If I had not come today, how disappointed the two old people would have been!"
He felt deep sympathy for them.

units.source_text: 便答谢道：“春到人间，自当先来道贺。

en.t: So he thanked them and said, "When spring comes to the world, I should naturally come first to offer my congratulations.
But sorrow fills my heart, and it is hard for me to put words together.
